Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner changed the death location to “Rancho Palos Verdes, California” without support from the sources. Wikipedia (as cited by WebSurfer) only indicated “Palos Verdes, California,” and the Los Angeles Times obituary specifically states “Palos Verdes Estates.” The Planner’s unsupported inference conflated different cities on the Palos Verdes Peninsula, leading toward an incorrect death place.
